milestone.title: Publish 0.7.0 against the complete acceptance gate
milestone.outcome: 0.7.0 is published against the complete acceptance gate: the perfect-realization gate runs to completion without waiver, every idle contract has a producer and a consumer, every requirement id is proven through the per-id trace, the artifact and platform manifests are frozen, limitations are rendered honestly including the D64 deferrals, unfired gates are sunset, and every publication target is observed.
exclusions: the requirement ids decision D64 defers to 0.7.1

acceptance_journey.expected_observation: four runs pass across two runtime profiles and two repository origins
